comment.body: Thanks for documenting that installing 0.99.0 requested the 0.98.1 MSI; similar prompts appear for earlier upgrades. To distinguish Windows Installer source recovery from an upgrade/repair problem, could you provide the exact MSI path shown, installation source and per-user/per-machine scope, and installer/update log from that same failed attempt? Remove your username or other private paths before posting. The visible error and version pair are already known, so these details focus the follow-up on this installer transaction.
